_comment: Keyed by operationId OR 'METHOD /path' for operations without an operationId. All fields are optional.

_schema.name: Tool name shown to the LLM (overrides operationId-derived default)
_schema.forcedQueryParams: Key/value pairs always appended to the query string (excluded from the tool schema)
_schema.excludeFromSchema: Parameter names to omit from the tool's input schema entirely
_schema.additionalContext: Appended to the auto-generated description (use this to preserve custom context across regens)

get-a-listing.name: get-listing
get-a-listing.description: Fetch full details for a single listing by mlsNumber. Use to display a property detail page or retrieve all fields for one known listing. Key params: mlsNumber (required), boardId (required if multi-board account), fields, locations. NOT for browsing or searching — use Search_Listings.

find-similar-listings.name: get-similar-listings
find-similar-listings.description: Return listings similar to a given mlsNumber by price range, type, and location proximity. Use to power a "similar homes" or "you may also like" section on a listing detail page. Key params: mlsNumber (required), boardId, listPriceRange, radius, sortBy. NOT a general search — use Search_Listings. If results look wrong or incomplete — see send-feedback.

lookup-address-history.name: get-address-listing-history
lookup-address-history.description: Retrieve all historical MLS listings for a specific address (sold, expired, cancelled cycles). Use to show a property's full MLS history. Key params: streetNumber, streetName, city (or mlsNumber / addressKey for a known listing). NOT for searching listings by criteria — use Search_Listings. If results look wrong or incomplete — see send-feedback.

get-deleted-listings.name: get-deleted-listings
get-deleted-listings.description: Return listings removed from the MLS feed since a given timestamp. Use for data-sync pipelines to detect deletions and keep a local dataset current. Key params: updatedOn (timestamp cutoff), boardId. NOT intended for property browsing — use Search_Listings for that. If results look wrong or incomplete — see send-feedback.

locations.name: get-listing-areas-and-cities
locations.description: Return the area/city/neighborhood hierarchy derived from active listings data. Use to populate location filter dropdowns or navigation menus with values that actually exist in listings. No key params required; results reflect the connected board's data. NOT for resolving a place name to a locationId — use search-locations or autocomplete-location-search. If results look wrong or incomplete — see send-feedback.

GET /locations.name: search-locations
GET /locations.description: Search locations (areas, cities, neighborhoods, postal codes, school districts…) by name or filters; returns names, types, coordinates and locationId. Use to resolve a place the user named into a locationId or to explore what areas exist. Key params: search (text), type[] (area|city|neighborhood|postalCode|district|schoolDistrict|school), city[], area[], resultsPerPage. NOT for listing searches — use Search_Listings. If results look wrong or incomplete — see send-feedback.

GET /locations/autocomplete.name: autocomplete-location-search
GET /locations/autocomplete.description: Type-ahead location matching: pass the user's partial input in search (min 3 chars) and get matching areas/cities/neighborhoods with locationId. Use for resolving ambiguous or misspelled place names quickly; filter with type[] to narrow. NOT for property/listing lookups — use Search_Listings. If results look wrong or incomplete — see send-feedback.

brokerages.name: search-brokerages
brokerages.description: List all brokerages registered with the MLS on the connected account. Use to build a brokerage directory or populate a brokerage filter dropdown. No filter params available — returns the full list. NOT for searching individual agents or offices — use search-members or search-offices. If results look wrong or incomplete — see send-feedback.

offices.name: search-offices
offices.description: List and filter offices (branches) belonging to the MLS on the connected account. Use to look up an office by keyword or ID. Key params: officeId, keywords, boardId. NOT for individual agent lookup — use search-members. If results look wrong or incomplete — see send-feedback.

members.name: search-members
members.description: List and filter MLS member agents on the connected account. Use to look up an agent by name, brokerage, or office. Key params: agentName, brokerage, officeId, keywords, boardId, position, resultsPerPage. NOT for CRM agents — use search-agents. If results look wrong or incomplete — see send-feedback.

buildings.name: search-listing-buildings
buildings.description: Search condo and apartment buildings referenced by listings on the connected account. Use to find a building by name, address, or location and retrieve its addressKey. Key params: buildingName, streetNumber, streetName, city, area, neighborhood, lat/long/radius, map. NOT for listing searches — use Search_Listings. If results look wrong or incomplete — see send-feedback.

places.name: search-places
places.description: Find points of interest (restaurants, schools, transit stops, etc.) near a location. Use to enrich a listing detail page with nearby amenities. Key params: lat, long, radius, type. NOT for MLS listings — use Search_Listings. If results look wrong or incomplete — see send-feedback.

find-agents.name: search-agents
find-agents.description: List and filter CRM agents on the connected account. Use to look up an agent record by name, email, phone, status, or boardId. Key params: fname, lname, email, phone, status, boardId, brokerage, externalId. Operates on the connected account's CRM data — not the public MLS directory.

create-an-agent.name: create-agent
create-an-agent.description: Create a new CRM agent record on the connected account. Use when onboarding a new agent to the system. Key params: fname, lname, email, phone, brokerage, designation, status, location, externalId. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

get-an-agent.name: get-agent
get-an-agent.description: Fetch the full profile of a specific CRM agent by agentId. Use to display an agent's details or verify their record before an update. Key params: agentId (required). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

update-an-agent.name: update-agent
update-an-agent.description: Update one or more fields on an existing CRM agent record. Include only the fields to change — omitted fields are unchanged. Key params: agentId (required), fname, lname, email, phone, status, brokerage, designation, externalId. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

delete-an-agent.name: delete-agent
delete-an-agent.description: Delete a CRM agent record from the connected account. Requires specifying a replacement agentId to reassign the deleted agent's clients. Key params: agentId (required). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

transfer-agents.name: transfer-agent-clients
transfer-agents.description: Move all clients from one CRM agent to another on the connected account. Use when an agent leaves or is deactivated and their book of business needs reassignment. Key params: source agentId, destination agentId. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

search-clients.name: search-clients
search-clients.description: List and filter CRM clients on the connected account. Use to find clients by name, email, phone, status, tags, or agentId. Key params: agentId, fname, lname, email, phone, status, tags, keywords, pageNum, resultsPerPage, showSavedSearches, externalId. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

create-a-client.name: create-client
create-a-client.description: Create a new CRM client record on the connected account. Key params: agentId, fname, lname, email, phone, status, tags, preferences, externalId. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

get-a-client.name: get-client
get-a-client.description: Fetch the full profile of a specific CRM client by clientId, including contact info, status, and tags. Key params: clientId (required). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

update-a-client.name: update-client
update-a-client.description: Update one or more fields on an existing CRM client record. Include only the fields to change. Key params: clientId (required), agentId, fname, lname, email, phone, status, tags, preferences, externalId. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

delete-a-client.name: delete-client
delete-a-client.description: Delete a CRM client and all associated data (saved searches, favorites, messages, estimates). Irreversible. Key params: clientId (required). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

rename-a-tag.name: rename-client-tag
rename-a-tag.description: Rename a client tag across all clients on the connected account that use it. Use to keep tag taxonomy consistent after a naming change. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

filter-searches.name: list-saved-searches
filter-searches.description: List saved searches on the connected account, optionally filtered by client or agent. Use to display a client's active property alerts or browse all configured searches. Key params: clientId, agentId, status, searchId, pageNum, resultsPerPage. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

create-a-saved-search.name: create-saved-search
create-a-saved-search.description: Create a saved search (property alert) for a client on the connected account. The search criteria drive automated match notifications. Key params: clientId (required), name, property filters (minPrice, maxPrice, minBeds, maxBeds, cities, neighborhoods, type, status, etc.), notificationFrequency. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

get-a-saved-search.name: get-saved-search
get-a-saved-search.description: Fetch the full criteria and settings for a specific saved search by searchId. Use to display or verify a client's search before editing it. Key params: searchId (required). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

update-a-saved-search.name: update-saved-search
update-a-saved-search.description: Update a saved search's criteria or notification settings. All filter fields are replaced on update — include the complete desired criteria, not just changed fields. Key params: searchId (required), clientId, and any filter criteria to apply. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

delete-a-saved-search.name: delete-saved-search
delete-a-saved-search.description: Delete a saved search. The client will stop receiving notifications for this search. Key params: searchId (required). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

filter-matches.name: list-saved-search-matches
filter-matches.description: List listings matched against a saved search on the connected account. Use to show a client which new listings triggered their alert. Key params: searchId (required), liked, viewed, status, lastStatus, startDate, endDate, pageNum, resultsPerPage. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

get-a-match.name: get-saved-search-match
get-a-match.description: Fetch the details of a specific listing match within a saved search, including the full listing data and the client's liked/viewed status. Key params: searchId (required), matchId (required). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

update-a-match.name: update-saved-search-match
update-a-match.description: Mark a saved-search match as viewed or liked/disliked by the client. Use to track client engagement with matched listings. Key params: searchId (required), matchId (required), viewed, liked. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

get-estimates.name: list-estimates
get-estimates.description: List property value estimates created on the connected account, optionally filtered by clientId or estimateId. Use to show a client their saved valuations. Key params: clientId, estimateId, pageNum, resultsPerPage. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

create-an-estimate.name: create-estimate
create-an-estimate.description: Create a property value estimate for a client by submitting property attributes. More attributes = more accurate result. Key params: clientId, address (required), details (beds, baths, sqft, etc.), overallQuality, lot, condominium, taxes, sendEmailNow, sendEmailMonthly. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.
create-an-estimate.additionalContext:
Before submitting, present all inputs to the user for review and confirmation. Details like bedroom count, property tax, or lot size directly influence the valuation — the user should verify them before proceeding.

Collect as many property attributes as possible. The more fields provided, the more accurate the estimate. Prompt the user for missing fields if they're readily available.

After receiving the response, interpret the confidence score for the user:
- Below 0.05: Excellent — strong comparable data available
- 0.05 to 0.10: Good — reasonable confidence
- Above 0.10: Low confidence — limited comparable data. This may indicate that some home facts are inaccurate or that the property type is uncommon in the area. Suggest the user review the inputs.

create-an-estimate-copy.name: update-estimate
create-an-estimate-copy.description: Update an existing property value estimate with revised property attributes and request a recalculation. Key params: estimateId (required), and any property fields to change (address, details, overallQuality, lot, condominium, taxes, sendEmailNow, sendEmailMonthly, clientId). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

delete-an-estimate.name: delete-estimate
delete-an-estimate.description: Delete a property value estimate from the connected account. Key params: estimateId (required). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

filter-messages.name: list-messages
filter-messages.description: List and filter agent↔client messages on the connected account. Use to view a conversation thread or audit communications. Key params: clientId, agentId, sender, status, startTime, endTime, pageNum, resultsPerPage. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

send-a-message.name: send-message
send-a-message.description: Send a message from an agent to a client (or vice versa) on the connected account. Key params: sender (agent|client, required), agentId (required), clientId (required), content (object with message/subject/listings sub-fields). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

get-a-message.name: get-message
get-a-message.description: Fetch details of a specific message by messageId on the connected account. Use to retrieve the full content and metadata of a sent message. Key params: messageId (required). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

get-favorites.name: list-favorites
get-favorites.description: List a client's favorited listings on the connected account, with optional status and tag filters. Use to display a client's saved properties. Key params: clientId (required), status, lastStatus, tags, boardId, fields, pageNum, resultsPerPage. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

delete-a-favorite.name: remove-favorite
delete-a-favorite.description: Remove a listing from a client's favorites on the connected account. Key params: favoriteId (required). Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

GET /nlp.name: list-nlp-search-history
GET /nlp.description: List past NLP search prompts submitted by a client on the connected account. Use to review a client's natural-language query history. Key params: clientId, nlpId. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.

GET /nlp/chats.name: list-nlp-chat-sessions
GET /nlp/chats.description: List NLP conversation sessions for a client on the connected account. Use to browse past AI-assisted chat sessions and their prompts. Key params: clientId, nlpId, resultsPerPage, pageNum, prompts. Operates on the connected account's CRM data.
